prompts.body: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: accurately registered FRONT/BACK albedo sheet for a Dragon Ball Z Super Saiyan Goku 3D anime character. Edit the provided two-panel projection sheet. Preserve EXACTLY the input 2:1 canvas layout, pose, every body outline, body landmark, face/eye placement, shorts hem, boots edge, waistband, hand positions and foot positions. Front remains left, back remains right. This is texture data baked onto an EXISTING UV mesh, so do not move or resize anything. CHANGE ONLY the painting style: make it authentic flat-colour late-DBZ anime / Dragon Ball FighterZ texture art. Crisp, confident thin dark-brown muscle contour lines; flat warm peach skin with a small number of clean angular shadow patches, no skin shine, no soft airbrushed gradients, no realistic shading, no mottling, no pores, no veins. Strong angular golden eyebrows above narrow determined turquoise anime eyes, a minimal small nose drawn with just two short lines, small single-line mouth, smooth cheeks. Keep facial landmarks in EXACT same places. Muscles should be described by a few clean ink lines, not realistic sculptural rendering or excessive crosshatching. Royal blue shorts and wristbands, navy boots with red trim and ochre soles retain exact positions, simplified graphic folds. Golden scalp root shape stays inside exact existing scalp outline with flatter clean yellow locks, no spikes outside the silhouette: a separate 3D hairstyle will be attached. Keep the entire original neutral grey backdrop exactly. No text, labels, extra frames, effects, aura or watermarks. Preserve registration meticulously. Output 2:1 landscape.
prompts.hair: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: square RGB albedo texture for angular golden Super Saiyan Goku 3D anime hair. Edit the input golden hair material. Replace the silky flowing banana-like stripes with extremely simple Dragon Ball Z animation cels: one dominant clean saturated golden yellow (#F8D844) field covering 75 percent of the canvas, TWO or THREE very broad angular tapered ochre yellow shadow bands running bottom-to-top, and just a few thin dark gold hair-groove ink lines. NO white shine streaks, NO gradients, NO fine strands, NO realistic hair fibers, NO curvy noodle patterns, NO skin, NO face, NO head silhouette. This is NOT an illustration of a person, just a flat unlit material that wraps solid sculpted polygon hair locks. The locks get their shape from the 3D mesh. Sharp graphic angular anime color patches, highly readable at small sizes. Fill every pixel edge-to-edge, no background, no borders, no text, no effects. Square image.
prompts.face: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: registered front orthographic face color projection for an existing 3D mesh. Edit target image: the supplied bald neutral 3D human head reference. Change ONLY surface colors on EXACTLY the existing facial features. Preserve every silhouette, face proportion, eyebrow position, eye aperture, nose bridge, nostrils, lips, ears, neck and image framing pixel alignment. Warm peach skin, golden blond eyebrows following the actual existing brow ridge, white eyeballs with small turquoise irises and black pupils at the centers of the existing eyeballs, subtly warmer natural lips on the existing lip surfaces. Bald scalp stays skin colored. Existing nose and mouth anatomy remain exactly as reference, use only subtle color differences; no cartoon nose mark or drawn replacement mouth. Clean stylized game albedo, matte, smooth simple color fields with minimal baked lighting. Neutral grey background unchanged. No new geometry, no hair, no enlarging eyes, no changing expression, no ink outlines around nose/lips/face, no text, no realistic pores. The output will be projected directly onto this exact mesh, so strict facial landmark alignment is essential.

scalpEdits.body: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: registered front/back anime body albedo projection sheet. Change ONLY the golden scalp/hair painted on the heads in BOTH panels into bald peach skin that matches the adjacent face/neck skin. Front is left: remove all golden scalp roots and widow's peak, keep golden eyebrows. Back is right: remove ALL golden head hair and replace with plain bald skin. All other pixels, figure outlines, positions, poses, eyes, face, muscle linework, clothing, backdrop and exact 2:1 canvas layout must stay unchanged. Absolutely no re-framing, repositioning, rescaling or new hair. Real 3D hair is provided separately; the underlying head texture must be bald. Preserve the current flat anime style and palette.
scalpEdits.face: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied front-facing technical face texture. Change ONLY the golden painted scalp/hair-root area above the eyebrows into plain bald peach scalp skin matching the existing forehead. Erase the entire golden widow's peak and all golden scalp markings. Keep the golden EYEBROWS exactly unchanged. Keep all eye, nose, mouth, ear and neck pixels/positions, linework, shadows, head silhouette, canvas size and framing unchanged. The character must have a fully bald skin-colored scalp in this texture because real separate 3D hair geometry will be attached. No new hairstyle, no strands, no extra objects. Preserve the neutral grey background and current crisp anime art style.

faceRegistration: Original bald human.glb orthographic face, [-.16,.16] x [1.49,1.81], direct projection without face deformation or landmark warping
faceRevision: Native facial features recoloured; original nose, mouth, silhouette and UV retained
